name: Amr

attributes.attribute: a grave that will not settle

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Amr, also Anir, is an Arthurian hero. He was said to be the son of King Arthur and to lose his life to his father's hand. His grave, among the Countless Stones of Wales, cannot be fired. Every person who tries gets a different answer, so the count never settles.

okr.objective: Record the Amr of the Countless Stones.
key_results: Show the son, the sword, and the measured grave.
okr.evidence: Monaghan 2003, s.v. Amr; Koch 2006, s.v. Anir
